originalTitle: 0rwx – A simple model of AI usage, inspired by Unix permissions
content: We need new language to talk about large language models. 0rwx is my attempt. A labelling system is vital for domain experts to talk about AI in a clear way. The difference between the 4 levels is not necessarily about what TOOL you use, but your ability to scrutinise the generated work. I have employed this simple framework to discuss my and others' work with less judgement and confusion, and I hope the 0rwx framework makes it just a little easier for you too. They are:
